Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that Imperial Noble Consort Chunhui’s husband (the Qianlong Emperor) was “Han Chinese,” and even misattributed the consort’s clan, despite sources indicating he was a Manchu emperor of the Qing dynasty. This factual error misdirected the determination of the husband’s nationality away from the expected “Qing dynasty,” leading toward an incorrect solution.
